description: RPG Maker information database common Item schema. Stable contract between collectors, archive, review, Slack and future public catalog integrations.

internal_id.description: Stable internal identifier. Not displayed publicly.

content_type.description: Top-level content kind. development_info is separate from downloadable assets, plugins and games.

resource_intent.description: Broad first-stage resource/non-resource/uncertain triage; independent of detailed asset taxonomy.

resource_intent_evidence.description: Small, explainable evidence list for broad resource-intent triage.

source_site_id.description: Stable SITE master ID; never use as public URL.

source_item_id.description: Stable source identifier when available; URL fallback allowed.

source_tags.description: Tags/categories preserved from the source before public taxonomy.

asset_type.description: Asset-specific subtype (graphic, sound, plugin, game, other). Use null for development_info; do not add development-tool subtypes here.

engine.description: RPG Maker engine/version that the item targets or supports. Do not use this for operating systems or runtime platforms.

source_published_at.description: Publication timestamp of the source post/page, normalized to ISO 8601 when possible.

classification_margin.description: Score gap between the best and second-best detailed sound classification.

classification_scores.description: Evidence scores by candidate detailed sound type. Primarily used for audit/debugging.

classification_evidence.description: Evidence supporting the selected detailed classification.

source_site_status.description: Lifecycle status of the information source; this does not indicate whether an individual linked material is still available.

source_site_name.description: Snapshot of the source name from the SITE master.

source_site_type.description: Snapshot of the source kind from the SITE master; distinct from content_type.

source_site_language.description: Languages used by the source site; distinct from languages supported by the item.

development_info_type.description: Subtype used only when content_type=development_info. Do not reuse plugin subcategory development_debug.

supported_platforms.description: Operating systems, devices or runtime platforms supported by the item; separate from RPG Maker engine.

links.description: Related URLs such as download, product, official, documentation or repository links. url remains the original source post/page. Each link may contain type, url and status.

publisher.description: Publisher, seller or distributor; distinct from author/creator.

price_amount.description: Numeric price amount only when explicitly confirmed; do not infer.

price_currency.description: Currency code for price_amount only when explicitly confirmed.

release_date.description: Product/tool release date; distinct from source_published_at.

collector_metadata.description: Namespaced source-specific metadata keyed by collector/provider. Keep broadly useful searchable fields in the common schema.

engine_relevant.description: Whether RPG Maker engine relevance applies to filtering/display; null means not yet determined.

file_formats.description: Explicitly identified file formats; do not infer from the page URL extension.

design_rules: Collectors collect source data; they do not define the public database taxonomy.
SITE master records describe information sources; collector modules are technical implementations.
Keep source-native metadata such as source_tags separate from the public taxonomy tags.
Keep legacy category during migration so Slack/report behavior is not broken.
Do not delete excluded records; retain them for history and review.
Do not assign public KN IDs before human approval.
PRE IDs are temporary review identifiers for unresolved classification or editorial review; they are not public IDs.
Classification review items are persisted in data/review/classification_review.json until explicitly resolved.
Do not copy or store source assets merely for cataloguing; store links and metadata.
Do not infer missing legal/licensing information as fact.
Automatic detailed classification may remain unconfirmed; low-confidence classifications must be reviewable by a human.
Keep human classification confirmation separate from automatic confidence so future re-enrichment does not silently turn uncertain classifications into facts.
Evidence scoring is used for ambiguous detailed sound classification; weak or conflicting cases remain needs_review rather than being forced into a category.

Detailed graphic and plugin categories use evidence scoring across source-native tags, title, category, description, URL, and asset tags. Multiple categories are retained only when they are strong and close to the leading evidence.

The classification pipeline is hierarchical: content/asset type first, detailed taxonomy second, confidence/review status third. A weak detailed classification remains needs_review rather than being forced.

Broad resource intent is recorded separately as resource_candidate, not_resource, or uncertain. Question/showcase context is a negative signal only when no concrete release/distribution evidence is present; paid price and external storefronts are not exclusion signals.
The resource-intent evidence is advisory and does not rewrite historical human review decisions.
Use content_type=development_info for RPG Maker development/runtime tools and technical information; keep development_info_type separate from asset_type and plugin subcategories.
Use engine for RPG Maker engine/version and supported_platforms for operating systems, devices or runtime platforms.
Keep url as the original source post/page; store additional download, product, official, documentation and repository URLs in links.
Keep source_published_at separate from release_date; keep author/creator separate from publisher/seller/distributor.
Keep collector-specific fields in collector_metadata under a collector/provider namespace; promote fields to the common schema only when broadly reusable.
